title: Stream FAILED ending names no resume when the cloud model gather fails
body:
ziy routes the stream path's FAILED ending through sayWatchFailedEnd(model). When watchGatherModel errors (only the cloud path can), model is statusmodel.Model{}: Host and EpicID are empty, so ResumeCommand returns "" and the ending prints the plain sentence with no command. Before ziy, epicOf() resolved an epic-<id> run's epic and named `ticfac run <id> --cloud`. Fix: when the gather fails, fall back to an epic the caller actually resolved (never the run-id fallback ziy removed).
evidence: internal/cli/watch.go:546-549 (sayWatchFailedEnd with the zero model when gatherErr != nil); internal/cli/watch.go:726 returns statusmodel.Model{} on error
